preconditions.description: n is the length of the string (1 to 1000), and p is the number of allowed first letters of the alphabet (1 to 26).
The input string s has exactly length n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:p] for c in s)
preconditions.description: Every character in s is one of the first p letters of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: not any(s[i] == s[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, min(i+2, n)) if j - i + 1 >= 2)
preconditions.description: s contains no palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (len(stdout) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:p] for c in stdout) and not any(stdout[i] == stdout[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, min(i+2, n)) if j - i + 1 >= 2))
postconditions.description: If stdout is not 'NO', it is a tolerable string of length n with characters from the first p letters of the alphabet and no palindrome substrings of length 2 or more.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (s < stdout and all(s <= candidate and (candidate != stdout or candidate < stdout) for candidate in [t for t in generate_tolerable(n, p) if t > s]))
postconditions.description: If stdout is not 'NO', it is the lexicographically smallest tolerable string greater than s. If no such string exists, stdout is 'NO'.
